verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Referrals API that can programmatically upload referrals to block and trust lists, which covers the blocklist-update part of the story. An official MCP server exists, but the evidence never shows it exposing risk rules, risk profiles or fraud posture. Custom rules and risk profiles appear only as Customer Area configuration, and case-management review applies to transactions, not to agent-proposed rule changes. missing for 10: programmatic read of fraud posture/risk profiles, API or MCP creation of velocity/custom rules, human approval gates for agent-proposed changes, evidence the MCP server covers risk management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates

citations.quote: You can use our Referrals API to automate uploading lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists.
Risk lists, also called block and allow lists or referrals, let you block or allow a transaction based on Adyen's data, your own data, or lists provided by third parties.
